description: skip and limit accept a parameter reference.

cypher.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.name ASC SKIP $s LIMIT $l

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.name ASC SKIP $s LIMIT $l $$, %s) AS (name agtype)

iso_gql.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.name ASC OFFSET $s LIMIT $l

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name)) ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT $l OFFSET $s

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name)) ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT $l OFFSET $s
